title: America named after the Peruvian god Amaru

tellings.quote: Yeah. Margo Vispuchi changed his name to be more like that, not the other way around.

plain: The name America comes from Amaru, a god of Peru, and the explorer Amerigo Vespucci changed his own name to sound like it, not the other way around. The comedian Kurt Metzger says this on the show. If true, it would mean that the name of the continents is older than European contact.
